title: Check one evidence file
responsibility: Read one declared evidence file, verify its stored identity and content, and release memoized source bytes afterward.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceFile.base
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceFile.input
inputs.description: Evidence pointer path and file declaration with path, storage, hash and byte length.

outputs.name: hubEvidenceFile
outputs.description: Bytes and an immutable file fact when intact, or explicit problem text for missing/mismatched declarations. A fact includes the verified storage blob ID.

errors.name: evidence-file-too-large
errors.description: Declared, stored or returned raw file exceeds the 50000000-byte ceiling.

errors.name: cache-hash-mismatch
errors.description: Materialized Git LFS bytes do not match the pointer’s declared content.
